issues.title: Make product monitoring automatic and provide an infrastructure landing overview
issues.body: Implemented local product candidates from exact known names, concrete CPE 2.3 identifiers and supported Log4j package identities; active default enrollment for recognized installed products during software creation, bundled initialization and vulnerability worker. The original review queue remains at /reviews/. Broader catalog aliases and version-specific patch recommendations remain separate. See docs/user-guide/infrastructure-overview.md. Performance: page-wide grouped counters, eager source loading, bounded per-asset problem windows and batched operator membership checks replace per-company/per-asset queries; query-budget regression covers twelve companies without caching authorization or upstream reads. Runtime verification follow-up: explicit web/worker restarts and health waits in every starter mode, authenticated overview Server-Timing headers and real retained-server/HTTPS browser measurements; local results do not establish user-machine latency. SSO follow-up: timing for real session validation and full inner Django processing, plus a loopback-only verified-TLS web-timing command that uses real existing Keycloak identities, compares HTTP/HTTPS and reports sanitized timing values; user-environment latency remains under investigation. Overview query compilation follow-up: the supplied slow-environment measurements locate the delay inside the view, not SSO/proxy processing. Disable PostgreSQL JIT locally for overview queries and restore the previous setting, including nested transactions/failure rollback. Add numeric per-phase/database/slowest-query timings; stress reproduction and normal real-SSO validation preserve current policy without a shared cache. Priority-query follow-up: post-update measurements still locate a single 6.7–7.3 s SQL call within priorities, so JIT was not confirmed as that environment’s cause. Rank only identifiers before bounded current-policy detail loading, skip legacy lookup for full cards, replace broad legacy/exposure exclusion joins with indexed correlated existence checks, and split ranking/issue/legacy preview timings. Larger synthetic fixtures validate bounded previews and policy behavior; user-machine improvement remains to be confirmed. Further counter/preview refinement after the user confirmed approximately two-second loading: share fresh scoped querysets only within the request, combine related inventory counters, use a correlated latest-risk visibility check, and limit watch/preview field loading. Preserve complete scenario fingerprints and current access checks; seven fewer database executes in paired local comparisons, with a modest company-admin timing gain and a larger CIRCL gain. User-machine improvement remains to be measured. Dense package-queue follow-up: reproduce the complete overview at 8.17 s on 10000 synthetic package-CVE rows; reuse request-local review bins and windowed issue counters/preview IDs, reducing the same full page to 2.21 s locally. Keep full policy/currentness and human-task semantics; no shared cache, schema change or production latency claim. Large retained-proof follow-up: the smaller fixture did not reproduce repeated JSONB extraction cost. A 10000-row fixture with ~29 KB retained context per proof reproduces 9.68 s; migration 0072 supplies a database-generated compact queue-proof projection and reduces the full local request to 0.99 s. Automatic projection updates preserve currentness under bulk/raw writes and keep full evidence/history/human decisions unchanged. Migration is now required before web/worker restart; production latency remains to be verified.
